name: Kiryuu Takaharu
source:
Hobbies: Being active
Likes: Cats, physical education, chicken and eggs over rice
Dislikes: Art, frivolous people

Takaharu sits next to Konatsu and has the same school shift as she. He can be a bit cocky, but he seems like a nice guy...

[spoiler]In elementary school, he was one of those who teased Konatsu.[spoiler]
